name: JustBookmarks
oneLiner: A local-first bookmark manager built for people who want durable tools.
description: JustBookmarks is the clearest expression of the Sellsword philosophy today: the software is yours, the data is yours, and the product stays useful without asking permission from a service.
It belongs on the front page because it makes the anti-SaaS position concrete instead of rhetorical.
features: MIT-licensed utility with practical day-to-day value
Evidence that these repos are products, not experiments
install: Clone the repo and follow its local setup instructions.
Use this website entry as the canonical publisher-facing summary page.
